title: The Generalized Sato-Tate Conjecture for Higher-Dimensional Abelian Varieties
exact_target: Are normalized Frobenius symmetries of every abelian variety distributed according to Haar measure on its Sato--Tate group?

sources.citation: T. Barnet-Lamb, D. Geraghty, M. Harris, R. Taylor, Ann. of Math. 173(3):1841-1869, 2011.
